channel.title: Rippling Automated Compliance (AC) Launches
channel.description: Latest product launches for IT admins (scope: it-ac)

item.title: Automated Compliance
item.description: Automated Compliance is now generally available. • SOC 2 compliance program with automated evidence collection across Rippling and connected third-party systems • Auditor portal lets auditors independently access and sample data, communicating with customers directly in the platform • Customers have completed audits with zero findings

item.title: Access reviews (Identity & Access Management feature)
item.description: [IAM team built this, AC has a monitor that tracks it] Admins can set up a quarterly Access Review in Rippling Third-Party Access app. The feature takes them through a review of each employee that has access to an app. Automated Compliance collects evidence of this process ahead of the company's audit. https://www.loom.com/share/c55bd6bf045843588cd91cac80be2c65

item.title: Launched Automated Compliance for GA customers
item.description: Helps compliance admins prepare for a SOC 2 audit with the policies, controls, and evidence they need. Once ready, they work with an independent third-party auditor to get a completed SOC 2 report. https://www.rippling.com/en-CA/products/it/automated-compliance

item.title: Risk register
item.description: Automated Compliance now includes a built-in risk register, replacing the manual spreadsheet workflow. • Survey-driven review of each risk, capturing inherent risk, mapped mitigating controls, and residual risk • Direct mapping between risks and the controls that address them • Generates the risk register evidence required for a SOC 2 audit
